newsitem.title: USA: Geotek knows no reason for stock decline.
newsitem.headline: Geotek knows no reason for stock decline.

text.p: Wireless communications company Geotek Communications Inc said Monday it did not have any fundamental reason for the recent decline in its stock price on Nasdaq.
Its stock was trading at 4-1/2 in early afternoon, compared to a Friday's close of 4-1/8, its lowest point during the last 52 weeks. Its highest point for the same period is 14-7/8.
A company spokeswoman was not immediately available for comment.
"In response to numerous inquiries by investors ...(the company would like to announce that it) knows of no fundamental reason for the recent decline in stock price," it said.
Geotek said it was expanding distribution to meet demand for wireless products with plans to enter into five new markets by the end of June.
On April 2, it said it had met first quarter subscriber targets and planned to launch into its next market, Tampa, by the end of April.
